AI Estimate Follow-Up for Housecall Pro (2026)

An estimate that nobody follows up on is a job you gave away. Housecall Pro's Pipeline can resend estimates on a schedule without you lifting a finger. The rest of the job is getting callers into Housecall Pro so the estimate gets written in the first place.

← All solutions · Integrations checked Oct 15, 2026 against vendor docs

🧭 Quick decision rules

  • You send a lot of estimates→ Ask Housecall Pro for a Pipeline demo. Its automations resend estimates on a schedule.
  • Estimate requests come in by phone→ Smith.ai logs the call on the customer record natively. Rosie can add the caller as a customer via Zapier on Essentials or MAX.

📨 What works with Housecall Pro

Labels show how each tool connects

Housecall Pro

Built in

Pipeline automations resend estimates and move them through first, second and third follow-up, then mark them declined after the last one. Follow-ups go by email or text, matching how the estimate was sent. You add Pipeline by booking a demo with Housecall Pro.

💵 Basic $59/mo annually ($79 monthly, 1 user); Essentials $149 ($189, 5 users); MAX from $299 ($329, 8 users).
Source: help.housecallpro.com

Smith.ai

Native

Native integration logs each call summary on the customer record, so the estimate request is already in Housecall Pro.

💵 Free: 25 calls/mo ($3/call after)
Source: docs.smith.ai

Rosie

Via Zapier

Via Zapier: adds the caller as a Housecall Pro customer (the only action its Zapier app offers).

💵 From $49/mo for 250 minutes; next tier $149/mo for 1,000 minutes.

Questions people ask

Does Housecall Pro follow up on estimates automatically?Yes, with Pipeline automations. They resend the estimate at the intervals you set, using email or text.
Can I change the follow-up timing?Yes. You enter the delay in days, and you can use decimals for hours, like 0.25 days for 6 hours.
Is Pipeline on every plan?Housecall Pro tells you to book a demo to add it, so check with them on your plan.
